steps: Open the UNC Research for Me study listing (rcid=6864, IRB 25-2189, status Open)
Confirm eligibility: female, 44-55, premenopausal or postmenopausal (up to 5 years from final menstrual period), feeling down/overwhelmed/disconnected
Contact the study team via the listing page
Complete the virtual visit (questions about thoughts and feelings plus questionnaires)
Complete the in-person visit (blood draw and MRI) within the one-month participation window
